Class NotificationTemplateRenderers

    • NotificationTemplateRenderers

      public NotificationTemplateRenderers(@NotNull @NotNull com.sca4d.core.api.i18n.LocaleCatalog locales, @NotNull @NotNull Collection<? extends NotificationTemplateRenderer> customRenderers)
